d: Dr. Claw, frustrated at the poor quality of MAD agents, goes to ask the help of a very old Sicilian don, the Great, Great Godfather. But GADGET proves more than a match for the Sicilian and his four sons.

GADGET has ordered a new watch. He gets his orders from Chief Quimby that MAD is unleashing weapons disguised as novelties. Dr. Claw is working with his old mentor, Les Renown, on a plot to do in GADGET.
INSPECTOR GADGET and Capeman have been testing out their new invention, the Gadzooka (a bazooka that shoots acid sour cream).
Sabrina has a crush on Dave, her new piano instructor.
Sabrina, sick of her seemingly mediocre existence decides the grass must be greener on the other side.
Salem is terrified to learn that the evil Toc-Toc is being released from suspended animation (a Netherworld corrections facility) for a crime Salem committed!

Sabrina and Maritza unsuccessfully try to convince Cassandra that littering isn’t cool. The trash in Greendale is so bad, that these “best friends for life” get their favorite skateboard star, Ricky Speed, to come and perform and clean up the pollution.
Sonic and Manic play a game of virtual reality to enhance their pilot skills.
Robotnik announces that he will marry Queen Aleena in a plot to become the king of Mobius.
Argus, a captain of the Queen's guard, is captured by Sleet and Dingo before he can reach the secret rendezvous where he was to meet Queen Aleena.
Moose is close to being cut from the football team unless he is able to bring his grades up.

Archie and the gang get a taste of what it's like to deal with teenagers when Mr. Weatherbee, Mr. Lodge and Miss Grundy drink bottles of contaminated water, causing them to revert to their wild teenage selves.
Archie is temporarily unable to type, so Reggie offers to write the Weird Mystery article for the school paper.
